8 bit number

0b00001100

2^8 = 256. 0 -> 255 (unsigned)
-128 -> 127 (signed)

10 + 3

0x34 -> 0b00110100 

1   -> 0b00000001 -> 0001 -> 0x01
8   -> 0b00001000 -> 0010 -> 0x08
10  -> 0b00001010 -> 0012 -> 0x0A
100 -> 0b01100100 -> 0144 -> 0x64

uint8_t device
0b00000001 = READING
0b00000010 = WRITING
